# pangolin_label_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a label to a site, a public resource, a private resource or a machine client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_label_attachment" "immich" {
  label_id    = pangolin_label.media.id
  resource_id = pangolin_resource.immich.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label_id` (Number) The label ID. Changing it forces a new attachment.

### Optional

- `client_id` (Number) The machine client. User devices are not supported: the API does not list their labels. Exactly one of `site_id`, `resource_id`, `site_resource_id` and `client_id` must be set. Changing it forces a new attachment.
- `resource_id` (Number) The public resource. Exactly one of `site_id`, `resource_id`, `site_resource_id` and `client_id` must be set. Changing it forces a new attachment.
- `site_id` (Number) The site. Exactly one of `site_id`, `resource_id`, `site_resource_id` and `client_id` must be set. Changing it forces a new attachment.
- `site_resource_id` (Number) The private resource. Exactly one of `site_id`, `resource_id`, `site_resource_id` and `client_id` must be set. Changing it forces a new attachment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID: `{label_id}/{kind}/{target_id}`, where kind is `site`, `resource`, `site_resource` or `client`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Composite ID: {label_id}/{site|resource|site_resource|client}/{target_id}
terraform import pangolin_label_attachment.example 4/resource/12
```
